pages.title: Regeneration Tank
pages.text: A clear vat of gel where a source at one end sets up a gradient, and cells read it to know where they are.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the morphogen source and its decay length. The gradient is c = c0.e^(-x/lambda), and it must still be read (above threshold) across the whole organ: lambda must span it. Too steep (lambda under a tenth of the organ) and the far end is blank.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Grown Organ, Matrix Fibre.
